name: Luna Vega
title: Full-Stack Developer & Digital Dreamer
tagline: Turning wild ideas into pixel-perfect realities, one commit at a time.
about: I am a final-year software engineering student at the Aurora Institute of Technology who fell in love with code the day I made a button change color. Since then I have shipped web apps, won a couple of hackathons, and broken (then fixed) more production builds than I care to admit. I care about delightful interfaces, clean APIs, and writing code that the next person will actually enjoy reading. When I am not programming, I am probably stargazing, baking questionable sourdough, or speedrunning puzzle games.
